name: footer-block
title: Footer block
description: A website's footer band: a hairline above, the footer row (the lockup, links and the domain) inside the page width, and an optional legal line in the muted gray.
use_for: The foot of every website page.
never: A second logo, social icons in color or a newsletter box inside it
The lockup recolored or resized below its minimum
source: Built from the library (footer row); the posts' and ads' footer row (lockup left, domain right) and the page templates' footer band
